sources.title: Gemini 3.5 Flash model card
sources.evidence: The exact card identifies the Gemini 3-series reasoning model, its text/image/audio/video inputs and text output, delegates architecture to Gemini 3 Flash, and describes hosted API/product distribution. It gives no total or active parameter count.

sources.title: Gemini 3 Flash model card
sources.evidence: The architecture reference explicitly linked by the 3.5 Flash card delegates architecture to Gemini 3 Pro. No parameter count is supplied.

sources.title: Gemini 3 Pro model card, updated May 2026
sources.evidence: The architecture section describes a sparse mixture-of-experts Transformer with token routing. The card explicitly lists Gemini 3.5 Flash among the dependent family models; no total or active parameter count is supplied.

sources.title: Gemini 3.5 Flash API model documentation
sources.evidence: Exact gemini-3.5-flash specifications list 1,048,576 input tokens, 65,536 output tokens, text/image/video/audio/PDF input, text output, thinking and function calling. The page updated October 12, 2026 says the identifier is deprecated and API requests are routed to Gemini 3.6 Flash.

sources.title: Gemini 3.5: frontier intelligence with action
sources.evidence: The dated May 19, 2026 announcement explicitly releases Gemini 3.5 Flash that day across consumer, developer and enterprise products. Direct HTML was successfully fetched after web-reader timeouts. It links the probe paper in s10 as interpretability background.

sources.title: Gemini API Additional Terms of Service
sources.evidence: The hosted service requires acceptance of Google API terms and these additional terms; the terms prohibit extracting or replicating underlying model weights. Together with the model card distribution section this supports proprietary, non-open-weight classification.

sources.title: Gemini 3.6 Flash model card
sources.evidence: The July 21, 2026 card identifies 3.6 Flash as based on 3.5 Flash and includes an exact Gemini 3.5 Flash comparison column. Its table contains benchmark and price comparisons, not total or active parameter counts.

sources.title: Gemini 3.7 Flash model card
sources.evidence: The August 13, 2026 later card identifies a distinct model based on 3.6 Flash. Its full text does not disclose parameters for Gemini 3.5 Flash.

sources.title: Gemini 3.8 Flash model card
sources.evidence: The September 2, 2026 later card identifies a distinct model based on 3.7 Flash. Its full text does not disclose parameters for Gemini 3.5 Flash.

sources.title: Building Production-Ready Probes For Gemini
sources.evidence: The first-party interpretability paper linked in the 3.5 launch studies Gemini 2.5 Flash; its full text contains no Gemini 3.5 Flash mention. Probe architectures and their sizes are not evidence of 3.5 Flash production-model parameters.

sources.title: A New Era of Discovery: Google Research at I/O 2026
sources.evidence: The May 28, 2026 research account attributes Gemini 3.5 Flash speed to speculative-decoding work, including block verification and tree-structured drafting. It does not disclose total or active model parameters.

sources.title: Models.dev Gemini 3.5 Flash record
sources.evidence: The upstream catalog supplies the frozen identifier and gemini-flash grouping; it was followed as a lead and is not the technical verification source.

name.note: Exact first-party model name and API identifier match.

developer.note: Developed and released by Google DeepMind; Google is the catalog developer label.

family.note: Normalized catalog grouping for the Gemini Flash series; official sources place this release in Gemini 3 and the Flash series.

release_date.note: Dated launch explicitly says Gemini 3.5 Flash is available that day; this is the public 3.5 release, not the earlier Gemini 3 preview or later 3.6 release.

open_weights.note: Distributed as hosted products and APIs under Google terms, without downloadable model weights.

license.note: Descriptive classification for the hosted model under Google terms, not the documentation footer license.

parameters_b.note: No total parameter count is disclosed in the inspected exact card, linked architecture cards, later comparison cards or research. Targeted exact-model parameter/training/interpretability searches yielded no first-party count; third-party hardware-based estimates are excluded.

active_parameters_b.note: MoE routing establishes sparse activation but not a numerical active count. The inspected primary sources provide no exact-model active parameter count; probe parameters are not production-model parameters.

architecture.note: Sparse MoE Transformer through the exact 3.5 Flash architecture section’s explicit reference to Gemini 3 Flash, whose architecture section explicitly references Gemini 3 Pro. This is documented inheritance, not an inference from branding.

context_window.note: Exact documented input-token limit. The separately documented maximum output is 65,536 tokens; these are not summed.

modalities.note: Exact model API table explicitly lists these input formats and text output; no image or audio generation.

reasoning.note: Exact model card identifies a reasoning model, and API table marks thinking supported.

tool_call.note: Exact API table marks function calling supported.

description.value: Gemini Flash model with multimodal input, text output, thinking and function calling.
description.note: Plain summary of documented capabilities for the historical 3.5 release.

patch.notes: Sparse MoE Transformer architecture follows explicit model-card references to Gemini 3 Flash and Gemini 3 Pro. Total and active parameter counts remain undisclosed. These specifications describe the May 19, 2026 release; Google now routes API requests using this deprecated identifier to Gemini 3.6 Flash.
patch.description: Gemini Flash model with multimodal input, text output, thinking and function calling.

summary: Confirmed all existing substantive specifications and the exact May 19, 2026 public release. Added proprietary license classification and sparse MoE Transformer architecture using explicit model-card references. Total and active parameter counts remain null after inspecting original and later cards and targeted research. Recorded that current API requests using this historical identifier route to Gemini 3.6 Flash.
